subject.title: fix(browser): bound Chrome launch stderr diagnostics

question: Should this external PR wait for real managed-Chrome launch-failure proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate for this availability-sensitive diagnostic fix?
rationale: The code path looks narrowly correct from source and mocked regressions, but repository policy requires real behavior proof for external non-docs PRs before merge unless maintainers intentionally override it.

options.title: Require live failure proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor adds a redacted terminal/log transcript or terminal screenshot from a real managed-Chrome launch failure on the current head.

options.title: Maintainer proof override
options.body: Allow review to proceed if maintainers decide the focused regressions are enough for this hard-to-force Chrome failure mode.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Leave the PR out of the merge queue if neither contributor proof nor a maintainer override is available.

recommendation.title: Require live failure proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor adds a redacted terminal/log transcript or terminal screenshot from a real managed-Chrome launch failure on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc made the current changes-requested review and is the clearest owner for whether the real-proof ask can be overridden.
